verdict.rationale: Pipedream offers an official `pd` CLI that deploys event sources from local or remote code and streams emitted events. It also has a REST API to create workflows and manage sources, plus TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs. Workflows themselves run server-side on HTTP, webhook and schedule triggers, so automation can run without the UI. However, the documented CLI centers on event sources, `pd deploy` without arguments opens an interactive menu, and nothing shows a CI pipeline setup. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, documented non-interactive CLI authentication, CLI coverage of full workflow deployment, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
